about: What a person can do here today, subject by subject, for Law, Education and Care. Built from what was measured and driven on 2026-10-12 (docs/INSTRUMENT_CELL_BRIEF_ASSESSMENT.md sections 23 to 25). A row changes state only in the round that builds it, and a journey names the test that drives it.
